post.title: Why You Think Everyone Is Mad at You #shorts
post.description: Arjun is sure Kabir is mad at him. Kabir just had his headphones on. Psychologists call this "mind reading": a cognitive distortion (Aaron Beck; David Burns, Feeling Good, 1980) where we conclude what someone thinks without evidence. Fix: ask before you assume. #psychology #shorts #overthinking #anxiety
